selection: Three non-overlapping body excerpts, also distinct from the existing hero selection at 24–46 seconds. All illustrate the same simulation recording, not separate experiments or controller comparisons.

clips.title: Sharing a connected road network
clips.caption: Vehicles move between neighboring intersections in SUMO.
clips.description: The overhead view follows two neighboring intersections linked by a multilane road. Vehicle symbols travel on the approaches and through the junctions as the screen recording pans across the network. These excerpts come from the same author-supplied SUMO recording, TL_medium.mp4. The window identifies colorado_medium.sumocfg. Vehicle symbols move along lane-marked roads on a white background; the complete application window and taskbar remain visible. The recording does not identify the controller, robot-vehicle share, or intersection-control configuration, and does not establish the performance findings. Original recording speed is retained; the source audio is digitally silent and is omitted. Source excerpt: 17–24 seconds.

clips.title: At the intersection
clips.caption: A closer view of vehicle movements through a simulated junction.
clips.description: A close overhead view shows a four-way junction with turning connections, lane markings, and vehicle symbols on its approaches. The recorded view then zooms out to reveal the curved connecting road. These excerpts come from the same author-supplied SUMO recording, TL_medium.mp4. The window identifies colorado_medium.sumocfg. Vehicle symbols move along lane-marked roads on a white background; the complete application window and taskbar remain visible. The recording does not identify the controller, robot-vehicle share, or intersection-control configuration, and does not establish the performance findings. Original recording speed is retained; the source audio is digitally silent and is omitted. Source excerpt: 48–54 seconds.
